title: beauty-agent — аналитика (ClickHouse)
description: События из Kafka в ClickHouse: расходы на LLM, задержка, воронка записи. Без персональных данных.

list.name: salon
list.label: Салон
list.query: SELECT 'Все' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT toString(salon_id) FROM analytics.events
list.definition: SELECT 'Все' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT toString(salon_id) FROM analytics.events

panels.title: Расход на LLM по салонам за сутки, ₽
panels.description: llm.call.finished, FINAL — дубли доставки схлопнуты на чтении

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, toString(salon_id) AS salon, sum(cost_rub) AS cost
FROM analytics.events FINAL
WHERE event_type = 'llm.call.finished' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, salon
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Расход по салонам и моделям за период

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(salon_id) AS salon, if(model = '', 'без модели', model) AS model, count() AS answers,
       sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost_rub) AS cost_rub
FROM analytics.events FINAL
WHERE event_type = 'llm.call.finished' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY salon, model
ORDER BY cost_rub DESC

panels.title: Задержка ответа агента по дням, p50 и p95
panels.description: Ответы с вызовом модели (кэш и guardrails не в счёт)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_type = 'llm.call.finished' AND model != '' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND ('$salon' = 'Все' OR toString(salon_id) = '$salon')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Воронка записи: написали → варианты → запись ИИ → визит
panels.description: windowFunnel по диалогу, окно 14 дней — как в analytics/queries.py (BOOKING_FUNNEL)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    countIf(level >= 1) AS `Написали`,
    countIf(level >= 2) AS `Показаны варианты`,
    countIf(level >= 3) AS `Записались через ИИ`,
    countIf(level >= 4) AS `Пришли на визит`
FROM
(
    SELECT conversation_id,
           windowFunnel(1209600)(
               toDateTime(ts),
               event_type = 'message.received',
               event_type = 'llm.call.finished' AND offers_shown > 0,
               event_type = 'booking.created' AND created_by_ai,
               event_type = 'booking.attributed'
           ) AS level
    FROM analytics.events FINAL
    WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts)
      AND ('$salon' = 'Все' OR toString(salon_id) = '$salon')
    GROUP BY conversation_id
)
